def transform(grid):
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 1 in row]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(row[c] == 1 for row in grid)]
    r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
    c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)
    obj = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    h, w = len(obj), len(obj[0])
    out = [[0] * h for _ in range(w)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            out[w - 1 - c][h - 1 - r] = obj[r][c]
    return out
